grain: reporter country x calendar year x import/export flow x HS two-digit chapter; partner is World, customs procedure is total and mode of transport is total

ranking.definition: Countries are attempted in descending nominal GDP (USD) for the requested year, using the project's IMF WEO sovereign series.
ranking.fallback: Countries without a GDP observation are ordered alphabetically after ranked countries.

limitations: This initial layer is merchandise trade only; services are not included.
Partner is World, so this layer describes product composition but not bilateral partners.
Country submissions arrive and are revised on different schedules; the importer should be rerun periodically.
The sum of monthly observations can differ from the separately compiled annual dataset.
Reporter exports need not equal partner-reported imports because of valuation, timing, routing and methodology differences.
